props.name: ariaLabelledBy
props.description:
Aria Labelled By attribute
- Dynamically set for A11y

props.name: heading
props.description: Heading text that appears in the header region

props.name: isActive
props.description:
Is active?
- **true** Shows the popover container
- **false** Hides the popover container

props.name: isDismissible
props.description:
Is dismissible?
- **true** Shows the popover close button
- **false** Hides the popover close button

props.name: position
props.description:
Positions the dropdown popover absolutely to the trigger.
- **default** places the popover to the bottom left
- **bottom-center** places the popover to the bottom center
- **bottom-right** places the popover to the bottom right
- **bottom-left** places the popover to the bottom left
- **top-center** places the popover to the top center
- **top-right** places the popover to the top right
- **top-left** places the popover to the top left
- **left** places the popover to the left
- **left-top** places the popover to the left top
- **right** places the popover to the right
- **right-top** places the popover to the right top

props.name: transitionDelay
props.description:
Number of ms of the dialog's open/close css transition delay
- Used to delay focus trap activation

props.name: variant
props.description:
Variants
- **default** Displays the popover panel with padding
- **menu** Displays the popover panel without padding

events.name: onPopoverClose
events.description: Fired when the popover closes by any means. Detail: `{ active }`.

events.name: onPopoverCloseButton
events.description: Fired only when the popover's close button is activated. Detail: `{ active }`. Use `onPopoverClose` to catch every close path.

events.name: onPopoverOpen
events.description: Fired when the popover opens. Detail: `{ active }` — the new open state.

slots.description: The main body of the popover

slots.name: footer
slots.description: The footer of the popover that appears below the main slot

slots.name: header
slots.description: The header of the popover that appears above the main slot

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: The trigger that opens/closes the popover
